Which of the following places is an evidence of Chalcolithic age in Andhra
x:
Patapadu is an important Chalcolithic (Copper Age) archaeological site in Andhra Pradesh. Excavations have revealed copper objects, pottery and other material remains belonging to the Copper Age, indicating the transition from the Neolithic to the use of metals. The discovery of copper implements provides valuable evidence regarding technological advancement and changing patterns of settlement in prehistoric Andhra.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (4).
